unit.why: A single narrative about R. Shmelke of Nikolsburg whose candle is relit by Elijah, told by the Apter Rav with a frame scene of his weeping.

stories.start_quote: מעשה פלא מהקדוש והטהור רבן של ישראל
stories.end_quote: ומי שהי׳ לו לב אבן נמוח
stories.summary_en: R. Shmelke of Nikolsburg, who denied himself sleep, finds his candle gone out while studying; a man reaches up from the ground to the roof to relight it. Through a yihud R. Shmelke learns that heaven sent Elijah, and he afflicts himself for months for troubling the prophet. The Apter Rav, retelling the story, falls weeping and moves all present to tears.
